descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper noun (אִיתָמָר) designating the fourth and youngest son of Aaron the high priest, who served in priestly duties and whose line continued through Eli. Rendered as 'Ithamar / Itamar' (eng), 'Itamar' (spa), 'ईतामार' (hin), 'إِيثَامَارَ' (arb), '이다마르' (kor), 'Ithamari' (swa). The two clusters differ only by the prefixed preposition ל ('for/to Ithamar'), a purely grammatical variation with no semantic distinction.
